pub_feat_title: One workspace from shop floor to board
pub_feat_subtitle: FabricOS links telemetry, orders, suppliers, and inventory so COOs, plant directors, and supply-chain leads run a single cadence — prioritized exceptions, shared KPIs, and packs leadership can defend in reviews.
pub_feat_control_tower_desc: Your executive cockpit: ranked exceptions across OTIF, cash-at-risk, and supplier shocks with drill-down to the order, asset, or vendor causing the signal — so daily huddles and weekly S&OP prep reference identical numbers.
pub_feat_control_tower_points:
Single prioritized queue blending OTIF slippage, working-capital drag, and supplier failure modes
Two-click drill from red KPI to order line, work center, or accountable vendor owner
Shared dataset for shift stand-up, capacity meetings, and investor-style variance reviews
Layouts tuned for CEO, plant manager, procurement, and program management roles
pub_feat_pm_desc: Reliability practices for plants that cannot tolerate surprise stops: equipment health, MTBF/MTTR discipline, work-order history, and assisted risk scoring on critical assets — aligned to how your CMMS already thinks.
pub_feat_pm_points:
Health indices and anomaly cues mapped to your maintenance strategy (run-to-fail vs condition-based)
Consistent MTBF/MTTR analytics across lines, shifts, and crews
Spares and criticality tagging so capex follows demonstrated exposure
Clean hand-off to CMMS / EAM masters without duplicating asset hierarchies
pub_feat_sup_intel_desc: Procurement-grade visibility: peer scorecards, reliability trends, and compliance artifacts compared consistently — enough depth for quarterly business reviews without spinning another BI program.
pub_feat_sup_intel_points:
Delivery reliability, lead-time variance, and quality signals consolidated per supplier
Benchmark vendors inside commodity, region, or program for negotiation leverage
Early-warning queues when a partner drifts outside contractual service windows
Structured evidence trail for customer audits, PPAP milestones, and CSR questionnaires
pub_feat_inv_desc: Inventory policy operations and finance can align on: ABC segmentation, explicit cover-day targets, dead-stock detection, and reorder recommendations grounded in demand volatility — not tribal spreadsheet factors.
pub_feat_inv_points:
Class-level policies with stated cover days and inventory dollar ceilings
Slow-mover and obsolescence lists ranked by revenue risk and carrying cost
Reorder suggestions that expose assumptions (lead time, MOQ, service target)
Enterprise roll-up across plants with transfer workflows and accountability
pub_feat_sim_desc: Stress-tests for SC and plant leadership: model supplier slips, demand shocks, and internal bottlenecks to quantify revenue, margin, and stockout exposure before committing capacity or capex.
pub_feat_sim_points:
Libraries of disruption templates — supplier delay, demand spike, asset outage, labor shortage
Scenario comparisons showing backlog, OTIF, and inventory trajectory side by side
Quantified revenue-at-risk and stockout likelihood for leadership trade-offs
Snapshot outputs you can attach to staffing, sourcing, or CapEx decisions
pub_feat_esg_desc: Sustainability reporting tuned to industrial reality: structured emissions and resource narratives, audit-friendly exports, and a monthly cadence your ESG owner can run without waiting on consultants each quarter.
pub_feat_esg_points:
Indicator sets aligned to OEM questionnaires, CSRD-style disclosures, and internal committee packs
PDF narratives suitable for customer audits as well as board oversight
Month-close friendly exports tied to production volumes and energy proxies
Version history when regulators or customers request historical substantiation
pub_feat_exec_desc: Leadership storytelling without re-building decks: summaries that stitch operational KPIs to financial signals — daily CEO pulse, weekly exec packs, and trends exportable to lenders or investors.
pub_feat_exec_points:
Morning digest translating OTIF, margin pressure, and delay drivers into plain language
Weekly alignment between operations metrics and working-capital movements
One-click exports for board decks, lender updates, and board committee read-outs
Variance narration versus plan, forecast, and prior quarter with audit references
pub_feat_ord_desc: Order economics your CFO can reconcile: margin-at-risk by program, OTIF trajectory, and supplier-attributed delay drivers — giving commercial and operations a single timeline during escalations.
pub_feat_ord_points:
Margin and OTIF curves by order family, customer tier, and manufacturing cell
Late-risk scoring with projected revenue impact and contractual penalty exposure
Supplier-attributed slippage tied to acknowledgements, promise dates, and expedites
Exports aligned to finance month-end cut-offs for accruals and revenue recognition
pub_feat_rt_desc: Operational pulse without another historian initiative: live equipment and line signals, exception queues, and team actions inside one secure workspace — tuned for shift handovers and escalation governance.
pub_feat_rt_points:
Streaming telemetry fused with orders, maintenance, and quality context
Alert routing by role, site, severity, with acknowledgement and escalation trails
Shift-ready views: what broke, what changed, who owns the next action
Enterprise-grade access controls for OEM programs and multi-site networks
pub_feat_freight_audit_desc: Computer vision + rules extract billed lanes, accessorials and duplicate invoices — reconciled against contracted tariffs and shipment IDs so finance recovers leakage without another spreadsheet war.
pub_feat_freight_audit_points:
Automated variance ledger by carrier with drill-down to invoice PDF pages
Duplicate detection across ASN, PRO numbers and billing cycles
Fuel index guardrails tied to each carrier appendix
Recovery pipeline with suggested dispute scripts and confidence scoring
pub_feat_carbon_tracking_desc: Scope 1–3 emission accounting with supplier-specific factors, CSRD-ready disclosures and predictive carbon curves — governance teams defend numbers with the same audit trail operations already trust.
pub_feat_carbon_tracking_points:
Supplier portal for PCFs, certificates and logistics legs
Hotspot map & modal splits for Scope 3 prioritization
CSRD / ESRS narrative generator with Excel audit extracts
AI anomaly detection on intensity outliers and supplier completion risk

pub_cases_1_title: From reactive maintenance to supplier-aligned uptime
pub_cases_1_meta: 240 FTE · single campus · AS9100-relevant production cells
pub_cases_1_challenge: Maintenance work orders lived in the CMMS while supplier delays were tracked in spreadsheets and email. Unplanned stops triggered expedites without a shared timeline across Maintenance and Procurement.
pub_cases_1_approach: FabricOS unified telemetry, CMMS tickets, and supplier OTIF on one canvas: maintenance events linked to incoming delay alerts, weekly reliability huddles with one KPI sheet, and hotspot prediction on critical spindles fed by recent vibration trends.
pub_cases_1_quote: We stopped arguing whose numbers were right — downtime and supplier slips finally share one clock.
pub_cases_2_title: One inventory truth across three co-manufactured sites
pub_cases_2_meta: 3 plants · ~180 FTE · refrigerated and ambient SKUs
pub_cases_2_challenge: Each site optimized locally while enterprise planning saw inventory only at month end. Slow movers accumulated, safety stock diverged, and emergency transfers eroded margin.
pub_cases_2_approach: FabricOS centralized inventory health with ABC segmentation, target cover days per class, and automated exceptions when any site drifted. Planners received one prioritized queue instead of three disconnected spreadsheets.
pub_cases_2_quote: Finally one signal for what to move, where to trim safety stock, and when to escalate — before finance sees it in closing.
pub_cases_3_title: Executive clarity without the weekly slide marathon
pub_cases_3_challenge: Six parallel weekly decks for Operations, Finance, and key customers rarely reconciled. OTIF improvements surfaced too late to steer capacity and supplier coverage.
pub_cases_3_approach: FabricOS executive surfaces combine OTIF, margin-at-risk, and delay drivers refreshed daily. Customer QBR packs export from the same numbers the plant reviews every morning — no last-minute reconciliation.
pub_cases_3_quote: Our COO stopped asking for another pivot table — the morning dashboard is the single source we defend in board and customer reviews.
